lastCompletedAction: Correction loop 1 for the AIM-002 / AIM-003 / FOUND-003 boundary. Migration 0076 gives an inbound provider message ONE canonical identity (channel + receiving account + provider message id + purpose, never message text) and an explicit dispatch lifecycle with leases, so one message is one row, at most one business dispatch, and the sweeper claims a receipt only once it was dispatched as a finance capture — the defect that made every inbound message, customer orders included, look like unprocessed work. Existing in_/evt_ duplicate pairs are reconciled by supersede-with-link where equivalence is provable and left visible for a person where it is not; nothing is deleted. The same migration fixes the review's confirmed database defects: the assignee capability re-check was a constant false (a user id passed where a company id was expected), TRUNCATE bypassed append-only routing history, an approval reference could point at nothing, an AI actor could supersede a human assignment, and channel-account write-uniqueness used a different key from read-matching. On the application side both analysis paths now route what they capture through one shared implementation, identical titles within one analysis no longer collapse, currencies come from the company rather than a constant, a credential error no longer dead-letters the queue, and the UI's presentational components are rendered in tests rather than grepped.
